ev.q: In 2021, 76.0% of women aged 50–74 years reported that they had a mammogram within the preceding 2 years.
The percentage of women who had a mammogram within the preceding 2 years increased with family income
In 2021, 76.0% of women aged 50–74 years reported that they had a mammogram
increased with family income, from 67.7% of women with family income <200% of FPL, to 74.3%
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
